title: MicroservicePrd:Payroll

decision_log.decision: Machine-readable PRD JSON is canonical; no new Markdown PRD is introduced.
OpenTofu + Makefile + oya ops are the deployment/ops path; manual SSH troubleshooting is explicitly out of scope.
HR, Payroll, and Accounting are the first children; platform model remains extensible for procurement, compliance, assets, and corporate intelligence.
ADR-0131/ADR-0132 flat microservice layout supersedes earlier tenant-rbac crate naming; Payroll implementation crates use oya-payroll-<bounded-context>-<layer> under microservices/payroll/crates/.

Payroll app-layer crate emits metadata-only audit and accounting integration envelopes over the pure payroll domain; disbursement, filing transport, persistence, and cloud adapters remain out of scope.

Payroll API crate owns serializable DTO contracts and deterministic conversion into payroll domain inputs; deployed HTTP routing, auth middleware, filing/disbursement transports, and runtime adapters remain out of scope.
Payroll OpenAPI v1 preview contract aligns to payroll API DTO crate shapes for trial close and accounting journal draft; deployed HTTP runtime, filing transport, and disbursement remain out of scope.

Payroll Jenkins LTS quality gate covers the payroll run domain/app/API package group plus the payroll OpenAPI contract; ArgoCD, Helm, runtime deploy, statutory filing transport, disbursement rails, and cloud adapters remain out of scope until deployable adapters land.

Payroll accepts HR leave payroll-impact metadata through pure domain intake, metadata-only app envelope, API DTO, and OpenAPI 3.2.0 preview contract; payroll calculation, HR service calls, storage, Workflow execution, and runtime audit emission remain out of scope.

Payroll runtime adapter crate binds payroll API DTOs to the repo-native Hyper router/middleware foundation and returns OpenAPI-aligned JSON responses; it is router-ready but does not deploy a listener, persist state, execute Workflow, submit statutory filings, call HR/accounting services, disburse funds, or calculate payroll.

Payroll in-memory storage adapter crate records metadata-only app envelopes for trial close, accounting dispatch, and HR leave-impact intake as a volatile reference seam; durable backend, Postgres/RLS, payroll calculation, filing/disbursement rails, Workflow dispatch, HR/accounting network calls, and audit-chain emission remain out of scope.

Payroll statutory rulepack provenance is modeled as a source-versioned manifest before tax calculation, filing rails, disbursement rails, or cloud deployment. Official source URLs and evidence digests are required so future calculation engines can prove which annual rulepack inputs they consumed without this slice claiming calculation correctness.
